description: This file defines the 'Message' class in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace, providing static utility methods for handling HTTP message objects, including converting messages to strings, summarizing message bodies, parsing messages, and constructing request URIs.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: A final class providing static methods for handling HTTP messages, including serialization, parsing, and summarization.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a MessageInterface object into its string representation, including headers and body.

methods.name: bodySummary
methods.description: Provides a short summary of the message body, truncated at a specified length, if the body is seekable and readable.

methods.name: rewindBody
methods.description: Rewinds the message body stream if it is not at the beginning.

methods.name: parseMessage
methods.description: Parses a raw HTTP message string into an associative array with start-line, headers, and body.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Parses an HTTP request string into a Request object.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses an HTTP response string into a Response object.
